assumptions.statement: Overall and key-area polygons are repository provisional geometry derived from public text descriptions; they are not official redlines or precise-area bases.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived ratios are internal concept comparisons and must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official SITE_BOUNDARY or KEY_AREA attachment is published.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, ownership, utilities, heritage, rail, road and engineering constraints are not included as cleared official controls.
assumptions.impact: No statutory control, parcel demolition, investment, or engineering conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Scenario cards describe low-risk reference workflows; no real model, personal data, vendor system, public-service deployment, or government program is asserted.
assumptions.impact: Professional, public, accessibility and data-governance review is required before any trial.

assumptions.statement: International cases are public method references, not evidence of local adoption or a transferable legal mandate.
assumptions.impact: They inform explanation, review and exit mechanisms only.
